Afrikaans

[edit]
Afrikaans Wikipedia has an article on:
industrie
Wikipedia af

Etymology

[edit]

From Dutch industrie, from Middle French industrie, from Latin industria.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /əndœsˈtri/
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

industrie (plural industrieë)

  1. industry

Dutch

[edit]
Dutch Wikipedia has an article on:
industrie
Wikipedia nl

Etymology

[edit]

From Middle French industrie, from Latin industria.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɪndʏsˈtri/, /ɪndyˈstri/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Hyphenation: industrie
  • Rhymes: -i

Noun

[edit]

industrie f (plural industrieën, diminutive industrietje n)

  1. an industry, business(es) that produce(s) goods or services
  2. (obsolete) diligence, industriousness

Synonyms

[edit]
  • fabriek, fabriekswezen
  • nijverheid

Derived terms

[edit]
  • bio-industrie
  • industrialiseren
  • industriecentrum
  • industriediamant
  • industrieel
  • industriegaren
  • industriegebied
  • industriepand
  • industriepark
  • industriestad
  • industrieterrein
  • melkindustrie
  • speelgoedindustrie
  • vleesindustrie
  • wapenindustrie
  • wijnindustrie

Descendants

[edit]
  • Afrikaans: industrie
  • → Indonesian: industri

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin industria.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɛ̃.dys.tʁi/
  • Audio; “l'industrie”:(file)

Noun

[edit]

industrie f (plural industries)

  1. (literary) diligence, zeal
  2. (literary) inventiveness, notably for disapproved purposes
    chevalier d'industrie ― knight of industry
  3. an industry, productive enterprise(s)
    capitaine d'industrie ― captain of industry
  4. a profession

Derived terms

[edit]
  • industriel
    • industrialiser
    • industrialisme
    • industriellement
  • industrieux

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Danish: industri
  • → Dutch: industrie
  • → German: Industrie
  • → Turkish: endüstri

Further reading

[edit]
  • “industrie”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012

industrie f

  1. plural of industria

[edit]

industrie

  • “industrie”, in Gaffiot, Félix (1934), Dictionnaire illustré latin-français, Hachette.

Romanian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French industrie, from Latin industria.

Noun

[edit]

industrie f (plural industrii)

  1. industry

Declension

[edit]
singular plural
indefinite definite indefinite definite
nominative-accusative industrie industria industrii industriile
genitive-dative industrii industriei industrii industriilor
vocative industrie, industrio industriilor

Spanish

[edit]

industrie

    1. first/third-person singular present subjunctive
    2. third-person singular imperative
